AnnotationSans-Regular.ttf is a static wght=400 instance of NotoSansSC[wght].ttf.
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanssc
Created with fontTools.varLib.instancer; original font naming retained.
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, included as LICENSE.txt.
Used only for annotation display and local PDF export. Font is bundled, no font CDN.
Full embedding is intentional: the tested fontkit CJK subset path omitted visible glyphs.
